questions.prompt: What shall I say to the augur when the sacred birds have flown away?
questions.answer: Quid augurī dīcam cum avēs sacrae āvolāverint?

questions.prompt: Should we bow to a tyrant who has broken every law?
questions.answer: Tyrannō cēdāmus quī omnēs lēgēs frēgerit?

questions.prompt: What was I to do, abandoned by my friends in a hostile land?
questions.answer: Quid facerem, ab amīcīs in terrā hostīlī dēsertus?

questions.prompt: Am I not to cherish the man who saved my life?
questions.answer: Hunc virum quī vītam meam servāvit nōn dīligam?

questions.prompt: What shall I answer to the judge who demands the truth?
questions.answer: Quid iūdicī vēritātem poscentī respondeam?

questions.prompt: Are we to endure such disgrace in silence?
questions.answer: Tantum dēdecus silentiō ferāmus?

questions.prompt: What was I to say when the augur foretold my ruin?
questions.answer: Quid dīcerem cum augur ruīnam meam praedīceret?

questions.prompt: Where am I to turn, driven out from my ancestral home?
questions.answer: Quō mē vertam ex domō patriā expulsus?

questions.prompt: Are we to believe the words of a man convicted of theft?
questions.answer: Verbīs hominis fūrtī damnātī crēdāmus?

questions.prompt: Why should I fear death, since I have lived well?
questions.answer: Cūr mortem timeam cum bene vīxerim?

questions.prompt: What were we to do, betrayed by our own commander?
questions.answer: Quid facerēmus ā duce nostrō ipsō prōditī?

questions.prompt: Shall I abandon the temples of the gods to the flames?
questions.answer: Templa deōrum flammīs relinquam?

questions.prompt: Are we to hand over the walls to a besieging enemy?
questions.answer: Moenia hostī obsidentī trādāmus?

questions.prompt: Why should I, though innocent, be punished for another's crime?
questions.answer: Cūr aliēnō scelere pūniar innocēns?

questions.prompt: Should I not cherish the general who led us safely home through the enemy's lines?
questions.answer: Nōnne ducem dīligam quī nōs per hostium aciēs incolumēs domum redūxit?

questions.prompt: What was I to do, abandoned by my allies on that dreadful night?
questions.answer: Quid facerem, ā sociīs illā nocte terribilī dēsertus?

questions.prompt: Where shall I flee, since every road is blocked by the victorious foe?
questions.answer: Quō fugiam, cum omnis via ab hoste victōre obsideātur?

questions.prompt: Why should I not honor a man of such great glory?
questions.answer: Cūr virum tantī decoris nōn colam?

questions.prompt: Where was I to flee, betrayed by my most faithful friend?
questions.answer: Quō fugerem, ā fīdissimō amīcō prōditus?

questions.prompt: Are we to surrender the sacred temples to the raging foe?
questions.answer: Templa sacra hostī furentī trādāmus?

questions.prompt: What shall I now say to the citizens who mock our defeat?
questions.answer: Quid nunc cīvibus dīcam quī clādem nostram dērīdent?

questions.prompt: Was I to spare the traitor who had deceived so many nobles?
questions.answer: Prōditōrī parcerem quī tot nōbilēs dēcēperat?

questions.prompt: Why should I weep, though the gods themselves have deserted me?
questions.answer: Cūr lacrimem, quamquam dī ipsī mē dēseruērunt?

questions.prompt: Are we to avenge our father, slain by his own brother?
questions.answer: Patrem ulcīscāmur ā frātre suō occīsum?

questions.prompt: Where am I to seek refuge, now that winter closes every pass?
questions.answer: Quō perfugium petam, cum hiems omnem saltum claudat?

questions.prompt: Should I not pity the captives dragged through the streets in chains?
questions.answer: Nōn miserer captīvōs per viās catēnīs tractōs?

questions.prompt: What was I to hope for, besieged on every side by the enemy?
questions.answer: Quid spērārem, undique ab hoste obsessus?

questions.prompt: Are we to hand over our children to a cruel and faithless king?
questions.answer: Līberōs rēgī crūdēlī atque perfidō trādāmus?

questions.prompt: Why should I mention the births, the sowings, the growths of vines? I cannot be sated with the delight, so that you may come to know the rest and solace of my old age.
questions.answer: Quid ego vitium ortūs, satūs, incrēmenta commemorem? Satiārī dēlectātiōne nōn possum, ut meae senectūtis requiem oblectāmentumque nōscātis.

questions.prompt: Is an inheritance to be claimed, one which is not owed at all, to become the praetor's plunder?
questions.answer: Petātur hērēditās ea, quae nūlla dēbētur, in praedam praetōris?

questions.prompt: Am I to grieve, or to rejoice at my husband's return?
questions.answer: Utrumne doleam laeter an reducem virum?

questions.prompt: What am I to say about Prodicus of Ceos, about Thrasymachus of Chalcedon, about Protagoras of Abdera?
questions.answer: Quid dē Prōdīcō Ciō, dē Thrasymacho Calchedonio, dē Protagora Abdērītā loquar?

questions.prompt: What am I to do, judges? Whither shall I turn?
questions.answer: Quid agam, iūdicēs? Quō mē vertam?

questions.prompt: What, should I not have come?
questions.answer: An ego nōn venīrem?

questions.prompt: Could I think that the defence of good men would ever fail me!
questions.answer: Mihi umquam bonōrum praesidium dēfutūrum putārem!
